title: Switched Teams at Mercedes Benz to the HV-battery and the eDrive team.
content: Since my old Team was resolved, I switched Teams to the eDrive and HV-Battery team. I am very excited to share that my tasks will switch from more hardware related to more software related. LEts see how this goes :)

title: Started Internship at Mercedes-Benz in the E/E-Integration Team
content: I started my internship in Data Analysis for the electric G-Wagon.

title: Startet working on my first very own chess Engine
content: Reading all the https://www.chessprogramming.org/ WebSite inspired me to try and work on my very first own chess engine. I want to run it on an Arduino and try to use the limited computing power it has to offer as efficiently as possible
